description: Find VPS plans, GPU instances or LLM models by name/id substring, category (vps|gpu|llm) and provider. Active SKUs on the provider's public price page or product API by default (listing filter). Returns each match's current list price, listing_status, unit and currency, verified_at, stale flag and source_url. Read-only; reads the ledger's own daily archive, nothing is fetched live.

listing.description: Listing filter. current (default) = on the provider's public price page or product API; catalog_only = only in an order catalog, not on the public page; vanished = was listed, now missing; unknown = no public page to check against; all = everything. Every row carries listing_status.
listing.title: Listing

provider.description: Provider slug, e.g. vultr, ovhcloud, openai
provider.title: Provider

query.description: Substring of the SKU name or id, e.g. 'h100' or 'claude-sonnet'. Empty matches every active SKU, ordered by category, provider, plan.
query.title: Query

name: search_skus
title: Search SKUs
